articles.headline: U.S. Panel Urges India Dialogue on Dalai Lama Succession
articles.brief: A U.S. Congressional panel recommends establishing a senior-level channel with India for succession contingency planning regarding the 14th Dalai Lama, warning that China may turn the process into an international legitimacy contest.

articles.headline: Indonesia Factory Blaze Leaves Dozens Dead and Missing
articles.brief: Authorities investigate a devastating fire at a confectionery factory in Banten province, Indonesia, which has left 24 people dead while rescue teams search for dozens still missing.

articles.headline: FSSAI Sanctions Prosecution Against Bisleri Over Water Tests
articles.brief: The FSSAI has sanctioned prosecution against Bisleri International after water samples were declared unsafe due to elevated bromate levels and detected polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons, though the company strongly disputes the findings.

articles.headline: Delhi Air Quality Enters Severe and Hazardous Category
articles.brief: Delhi's Air Quality Index surged to hazardous levels, reaching 456 on Monday morning. Officials noted that pollution levels are soaring twenty times above WHO limits, prompting strict public health advisories.

articles.headline: Longest UN Climate Talks COP31 Collapse Without Deal
articles.brief: The COP31 climate summit collapsed after hitting a historic deadlock, with nations failing to reach a consensus on a final text as deep geopolitical divisions and disagreements over fossil fuels paralyzed negotiations.

articles.headline: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang Scrutinized Over Intelligence Links
articles.brief: Reports reveal U.S. authorities and lawmakers are scrutinizing former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang over a past relationship tied to intelligence concerns regarding advanced chip export controls to China.

articles.headline: L&T Secures Major Deal to Deploy NVIDIA GPUs in Chennai
articles.brief: L&T has bagged a substantial deal ranging between Rs 2,500 and 5,000 crore to deploy advanced NVIDIA B300 GPUs at its newly developing data center facility in Chennai.

articles.headline: Tata Steel to Acquire 26.6% Stake in APL Apollo
articles.brief: Tata Steel has announced a major strategic acquisition of a 26.6% promoter stake in APL Apollo for a massive transaction value of Rs 15,510 crore.

articles.headline: India and New Zealand Draw Wellington Test After Resistance
articles.brief: The first Test between India and New Zealand ended in a tense draw at the Basin Reserve as Daryl Mitchell and Glenn Phillips put up a stubborn blockathon to deny India victory.

articles.headline: NHS Launches World's Largest AI Breast Cancer Trial
articles.brief: The UK's NHS has initiated the world's largest clinical trial utilizing artificial intelligence for breast cancer screenings, aiming to drastically improve early detection rates and alleviate health service pressures.

articles.headline: India's First Bullet Train Project Energizes Surat-Bilimora Span
articles.brief: The Mumbai-Ahmedabad high-speed rail corridor achieved a major engineering milestone after successfully energizing the 50-kilometer elevated section running between Surat and Bilimora.

articles.headline: Bangladesh Urges India to Initiate Ganga Treaty Renewal Talks
articles.brief: Ahead of the 1996 bilateral water-sharing agreement's expiry on December 12, Bangladesh has officially urged India to initiate negotiations for the renewal of the Ganga Water Treaty.

articles.headline: ITAT Rules No Tax on Dividend Earnings From REITs and InvITs
articles.brief: In a landmark relief for retail investors, the Income Tax Appellate Tribunal ruled that dividends earned up to Rs 50 lakh from REITs and InvITs are exempt from additional taxation.

articles.headline: Soviet Era Dominance Examined in World Chess Championship
articles.brief: As the global chess community gathers for the World Chess Championship, historians look back at the legendary Soviet systematic rule that shaped the game across sixty-four squares and beyond.

articles.headline: San Francisco Issues Severe Warning for Historic Coastal Flood
articles.brief: San Francisco is bracing for potentially historic coastal flooding as an approaching major storm and unusually high tides threaten to submerge low-lying neighborhoods during the Thanksgiving holiday travel period.

articles.headline: AI-Driven Biotech Careers Surge Amid Cross-Industry Applications
articles.brief: Biotechnology is rapidly emerging as a premier career choice for modern graduates, with cross-disciplinary applications spanning pharmaceuticals, agriculture, and computational health technologies.
